svg.aria-label: Checks after crimping: wipe the case clean with isopropanol and write a number on it. Multimeter readings: an SS symmetric cell shows a very high resistance that slowly rises; an SS | PTFE | SS blank cell shows OL; a Li symmetric cell reads about 0 mV; for an SS | Li cell, record the open-circuit voltage. Close to 0 ohms means a short; reassemble. For a charged cell, use only the voltage range.
